Name: Skip or Socialize - Replace Skip Button For Important Events (Dialogue Helper - UI Support)
Author: DylanJames
Description:

[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
⧉ㅤ[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]

[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
When you begin an event with friendship dialogue, the skip button will change to reflect it.
This includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]mod-added events[/url], because it scans for any responses that affect friendship.


[b][size=4]SUPPORTED UI RECOLORS[/size][/b]

You can select your recolors in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url] installed.
You are looking for the entry [u]"(CP) Skip or Socialize"[/u]. Typically located at the top of the list.
